bio.text: Mark Amodei has served as the U.S. Representative for Nevada's 2nd Congressional District since 2011 and sits on the House Appropriations Committee.
He was born in Carson City on June 12, 1958, graduated from the University of Nevada in 1980, and received a law degree from McGeorge School of Law in 1983.
He served in the U.S. Army Judge Advocate General Corps from 1983 to 1987.
He served in the Nevada Assembly from 1996 to 1998 and the Nevada State Senate from 1998 to 2010, and was chairman of the Nevada Republican Party until May 2011.
